name: Epic Siren's Belt
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Siren's Belt

effects.name: Armor Bonus
effects.tooltip: Armor Bonus +9 : This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +9 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.

effects.name: Protection
effects.tooltip: Protection +8 : Passive: +8 Deflection bonus to Armor Class .

effects.name: Shield
effects.tooltip: Shield +9 : While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +9 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.

effects.name: Proof Against Disease
effects.tooltip: Proof Against Disease +6 : This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +6 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 7 + their Fortitude save).

effects.name: Epic Siren's Ward
effects.tooltip: Epic Siren's Ward : 2 Pieces Equipped: +10% Artifact bonus to Armor Class +3 Artifact bonus to all Saving Throws +3 Artifact bonus to Shield Armor Class

flavor_text: This rare belt is enchanted with the protective magic of a water spirit and is capable of defending the wearer from harm.
tips: Legacy Scroll/Seal/Shard for this item are wrongfully named "... of Siren's Bracers"
